desc: Derive a rigorous characterization of collisions between orientations that produce the same in-degree sequence.
Find and prove an \(O(N)\), constant-state method for counting distinct degree sequences, including the apex degree and cyclic boundary.
Handle special configurations such as all-zero/all-one strings and runs of equal bits.
Validate the recurrence by brute force for small \(N\) and the two samples.
Produce a memory-efficient Python implementation for \(N\le 10^6\), modulo \(998244353\).
